data.description: A spiral slide takes up less floor space than a straight one of the same height, because the chute wraps around itself. Our 5 ft Spiral Slide does exactly that, with a red open spiral and a steel ladder. Children go round in a full turn before they reach the bottom, which feels fast and exciting without being high. That compact footprint makes it a good option for a society garden or school courtyard where space is tight. The colour is Play Red. The 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts applies here too. Share the size of your space and we will check whether the spiral fits.

items.pText: A spiral slide takes up less floor space than a straight one of the same height, because the chute wraps around itself. Our 5 ft Spiral Slide does exactly that, with a red open spiral and a steel ladder. Children go round in a full turn before they reach the bottom, which feels fast and exciting without being high. That compact footprint makes it a good option for a society garden or school courtyard where space is tight. The colour is Play Red. The 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts applies here too. Share the size of your space and we will check whether the spiral fits.

The spiral bed is moulded and the ladder and supports are galvanised steel. We install it self-standing or grouted. The exit faces a different direction from the ladder, so mark both on your layout, keep an impact-absorbing surface at the foot, and inspect the spiral joints during maintenance.
